flags.summary: Prospect disclosed a first-degree family history of fatal heart attack, diabetic grandparents and previously undiagnosed sleep apnea at 5'9" and 240 lb, and was moved toward high-intensity loaded ballistic training with no health-history question and no clinical clearance sought.
evidence: The other thing I didn't mention is my father did pass away, and as far as we can tell, it was from a heart attack. And he was more obese
I had undiagnosed sleep apnea, and I would just sleep all the time in school, but pass out sleeping, I mean, but I've got that under control now
I'm only 5'9", and I weigh 240 pounds
Yeah. Okay. So, you want to focus on getting your energy in place and keeping it in place having that longevity aspect

flags.summary: Prospect reported that the kettlebell work itself is aggravating an old shoulder and elbow injury and that he believes his own bells are heavy enough to injure him; the rep responded with a claim that the programme would resolve the shoulder rather than suggesting assessment.
evidence: I've noticed in a few of the swings I've been doing lately, I've had some shoulder stuff, which I used to throw. I threw track and field in college, and I know I definitely messed up my shoulder and elbow a little bit... the kettlebells have definitely brought that out
that 45 pounds is like, I feel like I could hurt myself more if I do it, if I do it wrong
I had reconstructive surgery on my wrist
eventually your body's going to get used to the movements, will make your body feel a lot more free, you're not going to feel your shoulders that much, your upper back will get more straight

flags.summary: A non-clinician made specific structural and physiological claims about correcting a decade-old upper-back condition and a post-surgical shoulder.
evidence: your body is going to have to align all of its joints, because that's going to help it do all of the movements
your upper back will get more straight, and that will just help with overall increasing your strength
I've had some upper back issues since I was in high school. I'm 33 now.

flags.summary: The rep confirmed there are no further costs beyond the $6,000, to a prospect who had just been told he would need more equipment.
evidence: It's not like there's, there's just an investment, there's not like a subscription, or like, okay. No, it's that investment and there's no extra hidden things besides it.

this is where I feel like I need a little bit lighter, because that 45 pounds is like, I feel like I could hurt myself

flags.summary: Connection quality degraded at the decisive moment — the rep missed the prospect's reaction to the price and had to ask him to repeat it.
evidence: What's that? Did you hear everything that I said or did you just miss everything?
